items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: He says, 'Man, I like your bass playing. Do you think you could teach me some?'

ctx.x: to sleep and we had a matinee that Sunday and I didn't make the gig and he said, "I looked for you and you didn't show up that night. What happened?" So that was just one time, but Al Gray teases me now. He says, "Yeah, here's the only cat, Nat Cole walked over and shook his hand instead of my hand and I'm the leader of the band."
But I enjoyed those little things. But I had a chance to -- you know Ezzard Charles, the late Ezzard Charles?
